nodes.label: Psoriasis
nodes.description: Psoriasis is a chronic immune-mediated inflammatory skin disorder characterized by well-demarcated, scaly plaques. It commonly affects the scalp, elbows, knees, and other areas and may also involve the joints.

nodes.label: Vata
nodes.description: Vata is the Dosha responsible for movement and regulation of bodily activities, including breathing, circulation, nerve functions, movement of limbs, and elimination. It is predominantly composed of Air and Space elements.

nodes.label: Pitta
nodes.description: Pitta is the Dosha responsible for digestion, metabolism, transformation, and maintenance of body temperature. It is predominantly composed of Fire and Water elements.

nodes.label: Kapha
nodes.description: Kapha is the Dosha responsible for stability, strength, lubrication, nourishment, and structural integrity of the body. It is predominantly composed of Water and Earth elements.

nodes.label: Ekakushtha
nodes.description: Ekakushtha is a type of Kshudrakushtha representing minor skin disorders that are typically less severe but still require attention.

nodes.label: Kitibha Kushta
nodes.description: Kitibha Kushta, which is characterized by reddish patches, indurated, Itching, and Scaling.

nodes.label: Mandala Kushtha
nodes.description: Mandala Kushtha a type of Maha Kushtha is a chronic of Kushtha

nodes.label: Abhyanga
nodes.description: whole body oil massage

nodes.label: Deepana Pachana
nodes.description: Therapy that enhances digestion and clears metabolic toxins.

nodes.label: Ghritpana
nodes.description: Therapeutic oral intake of medicated ghee.

nodes.label: Kashaya Dhara
nodes.description: pouring of medicated decoction over the body

nodes.label: Nadi Swedana
nodes.description: Localized steam sudation using a tube.

nodes.label: Pachana
nodes.description: Therapy that promotes digestion and metabolic clearance.

nodes.label: Rukshana
nodes.description: Drying and reducing therapy.

nodes.label: Sarvangya Snehana
nodes.description: Full-body oleation therapy.

nodes.label: Snehapana
nodes.description: Internal administration of medicated oil or ghee.

nodes.label: Dhumpana
nodes.description: Therapeutic inhalation of medicated smoke.

nodes.label: Oral Medication

nodes.label: Rasayana
nodes.description: Rejuvenative therapy promoting health and vitality.

nodes.label: Samsarjana Karma
nodes.description: Gradual dietary restoration after purification.

nodes.label: Shamana

nodes.label: Koshtha Pareeksha
nodes.description: Assessment of bowel and digestive function.

nodes.label: Raktamokshana
nodes.description: Therapeutic bloodletting.

nodes.label: Swedana

nodes.label: Vamana
nodes.description: Therapeutic emesis for elimination of aggravated doshas.

nodes.label: Virechana
nodes.description: Therapeutic purgation for elimination of aggravated doshas.

nodes.label: Candle Grease Test
nodes.description: A traditional clinical test used to assess characteristics of a skin lesion, particularly scaling or surface changes.

nodes.label: Dermatological Life Quality Index (Dlqi)
nodes.description: Measures the impact of skin disease on a patient's quality of life.

nodes.label: Lipid Profile
nodes.description: Measures cholesterol and triglyceride fractions to assess lipid status and cardiovascular risk.

nodes.label: Psoriasis Area And Severity Index (Pasi) Score
nodes.description: Quantifies psoriasis severity based on affected body surface area and lesion characteristics.

nodes.label: Relief In The Signs And Symptoms
nodes.description: Measures improvement in clinical manifestations following treatment.

nodes.label: Acute Prolapsed Inter-Vertebral Disc
nodes.description: Acute prolapsed inter-vertebral disc (IVDP) is a painful condition that requires immediate treatment by conservative or surgical management. Though majority of patients show remission in symptoms with conservative treatment, regression of herniated disc with non-surgical management has been rarely reported.

nodes.label: Acute Upper Limb Ischemia
nodes.description: Acute upper limb ischemia (AULI) is a medical and surgical emergency involving sudden decrease in limb perfusion resulting in threat for limb viability. The approximate incidence of AULI is 1.5 cases/10,000 people per year.

nodes.label: Alopecia
nodes.description: Alopecia is the medical term for hair loss. It can mean small round patches missing from the scalp (alopecia areata), total loss of head hair (alopecia totalis), or loss of all body hair (alopecia universalis).

nodes.label: Amyotrophic Lateral Sclerosis
nodes.description: Amyotrophic lateral sclerosis (ALS) affects human life in various ways. ALS with multifocal onset might exhibit muscle stiffness and muscle weakness of upper and lower limbs, muscle twitching, atrophy, falling/tripping, slurred speech, difficulty in swallowing and loss of dexterity.

nodes.label: Ankylosing Spondylitis
nodes.description: Ankylosing spondylitis (AS) is a chronic inflammatory disorder that primarily involves the sacroiliac joints and the axial skeleton. There is also a variable involvement of peripheral joints and articular structures.

nodes.label: Antiphospholipid Antibody Syndrome
nodes.description: Anti-phospholipid antibody (APLA) syndrome is defined by the presence of thrombo-embolic complications and pregnancy morbidity in the presence of persistently increased titers of APLA syndrome.

nodes.label: Autoimmune Pancreatitis
nodes.description: AIP is a rare disorder, its exact cause is unknown, but it is thought to be caused by the body's immune system attacking the pancreas and it responds to steroid therapy only.

nodes.label: Avascular Necrosis
nodes.description: Avascular necrosis (AVN) of the bone is a condition characterized by the death or necrosis of bone tissue, accompanied by structural changes. It is also referred to as osteonecrosis or ischemic necrosis of the bone. It is mostly seen in patients having a history of excessive alcohol and high-dose steroid medications.

nodes.label: Bell's Palsy
nodes.description: Bell's palsy or Facial nerve palsy is a condition that causes temporary weakness or paralysis of the muscles in the face.

nodes.label: Benign Prostatic Hyperplasia
nodes.description: BPH is a nonmalignant enlargement of the prostate gland caused by excessive growth of the prostatic tissue and is the most common benign neoplasm of aging men mainly above 40 years.

nodes.label: Bleeding Piles
nodes.description: Bleeding piles (hemorrhoids) are swollen, inflamed blood vessels in the rectum or anus that often produce painless, bright red blood during bowel movements.

nodes.label: Bronchial Asthma
nodes.description: Bronchial asthma is a long-term lung disease that inflames and narrows the airways. It causes recurring bouts of wheezing, chest tightness, shortness of breath, and coughing.

nodes.label: Central Serous Retinopathy
nodes.description: Central serous retinopathy (CSR), or central serous chorioretinopathy, occurs when fluid leaks under the retina, forming a small detachment that blurs or distorts central vision.

nodes.label: Cerebral Palsy
nodes.description: Cerebral palsy is a group of permanent movement and posture disorders caused by abnormal development or damage to the developing brain, usually before or during birth.

nodes.label: Cervical Spondylosis
nodes.description: Cervical spondylosis is a degenerative condition of the cervical spine caused by age-related changes in the vertebrae, intervertebral discs, and surrounding structures. It may cause neck pain, stiffness, and restricted movement.

nodes.label: Cervical Spondylotic Myelopathy
nodes.description: Cervical spondylotic myelopathy is a neurological condition caused by compression of the spinal cord due to degenerative changes in the cervical spine. It may result in weakness, sensory disturbances, impaired coordination, and difficulty walking.

nodes.label: Chemotherapy-Induced Peripheral Neuropathy
nodes.description: Chemotherapy-induced peripheral neuropathy is nerve damage resulting from certain anticancer drugs. It commonly presents with numbness, tingling, burning pain, weakness, or altered sensation, particularly in the hands and feet.

nodes.label: Chronic Alchoholism
nodes.description: Chronic alcoholism refers to prolonged and excessive alcohol consumption associated with dependence and adverse physical, psychological, and social consequences. It can affect multiple organs and may lead to neurological and metabolic complications.

nodes.label: Chronic Low Back Pain
nodes.description: Chronic low back pain is persistent or recurrent pain affecting the lower back for an extended period. It may be associated with spinal degeneration, muscular problems, nerve involvement, or other underlying conditions.

nodes.label: Chronic Non-Healing Ulcer
nodes.description: A chronic non-healing ulcer is a wound that fails to heal through the normal stages of tissue repair. It may persist because of factors such as poor blood supply, infection, diabetes, or repeated trauma.

nodes.label: Chronic Sinusitis
nodes.description: Chronic sinusitis is persistent inflammation of the paranasal sinuses lasting for an extended period. It commonly causes nasal obstruction, nasal discharge, facial pressure or pain, and reduced sense of smell.

nodes.label: Chronic Urticaria
nodes.description: Chronic urticaria is a condition characterized by recurrent episodes of itchy wheals (hives), with or without swelling, occurring without a consistently identifiable external trigger.

nodes.label: Coma
nodes.description: Coma is a prolonged state of profound unconsciousness in which an individual cannot be awakened and does not respond normally to external stimuli. It may result from severe brain injury, stroke, metabolic disturbances, poisoning, or other serious conditions.

nodes.label: Covid-19
nodes.description: COVID-19 is an infectious disease caused by the severe acute respiratory syndrome coronavirus 2 (SARS-CoV-2). It primarily affects the respiratory system but can involve multiple organs and produce symptoms ranging from mild illness to severe disease.

nodes.label: Depression
nodes.description: Depression is a mental health disorder characterized by persistent sadness or low mood, loss of interest or pleasure, and associated emotional, cognitive, behavioural, and physical symptoms that can interfere with daily functioning.

nodes.label: Diabetes Mellitus
nodes.description: Diabetes mellitus is a chronic metabolic disorder characterized by elevated blood glucose levels resulting from inadequate insulin production, impaired insulin action, or a combination of both. Persistent hyperglycaemia can lead to complications affecting multiple organs.

nodes.label: Diabetic Foot Ulcer
nodes.description: A diabetic foot ulcer is a chronic open wound occurring on the foot in individuals with diabetes. It is commonly associated with diabetic neuropathy, impaired circulation, and delayed wound healing.

nodes.label: Diabetic Retinopathy
nodes.description: Diabetic retinopathy is a complication of diabetes that affects the blood vessels of the retina. Progressive retinal damage can cause visual disturbances and, in advanced cases, significant vision loss.

nodes.label: Diplopia
nodes.description: Diplopia, commonly known as double vision, is a visual disturbance in which a person perceives two images of a single object. It may occur due to abnormalities involving the eyes, ocular muscles, or the nerves controlling eye movement.

nodes.label: Dyslipidemia
nodes.description: Dyslipidemia is an abnormal level or composition of lipids in the blood, including elevated cholesterol or triglycerides and/or reduced high-density lipoprotein cholesterol. It is an important risk factor for cardiovascular disease.

nodes.label: Dysmenorrhea
nodes.description: Dysmenorrhea refers to painful menstruation, typically characterized by cramping pain in the lower abdomen during the menstrual period. It may also be accompanied by symptoms such as backache, nausea, or fatigue.

nodes.label: Dysuria
nodes.description: Dysuria refers to painful, burning, or uncomfortable urination. It is commonly associated with infections or inflammation of the urinary tract but may occur due to other urinary or genital conditions.

nodes.label: Eczema
nodes.description: Eczema is a skin disorder characterized by Itching erythema, Scaling, Edema, vesiculation, and Discharge

nodes.label: Endometrial Calcification
nodes.description: Endometrial calcification refers to the abnormal deposition of calcium within the endometrial lining of the uterus.

nodes.label: Endometrioma
nodes.description: An endometrioma is a cyst formed when endometrial-like tissue grows within the ovary, commonly resulting from endometriosis.

nodes.label: Epidermolysis Bullosa
nodes.description: Epidermolysis bullosa (EB) is a group of inherited rare skin disorders that causes the skin to become fragile and blister easily due to minor trauma or friction.

nodes.label: Episodic Cluster Headache
nodes.description: Episodic cluster headache is a neurological disorder characterized by recurrent attacks of severe, usually one-sided headache, often accompanied by symptoms such as tearing, nasal congestion, or redness of the eye on the affected side.

nodes.label: Erythrodermic Psoriasis
nodes.description: Psoriasis is a noninfectious chronic inflammatory skin disorder, characterized by well-defined erythematous plaques with silvery scales.

nodes.label: Esophageal Squamous Cell Carcinoma
nodes.description: Esophageal squamous cell carcinoma is a malignant tumor arising from the squamous epithelial cells lining the esophagus.

nodes.label: Female Infertility
nodes.description: Female infertility is the inability to achieve pregnancy after regular unprotected sexual intercourse for a defined period.

nodes.label: Fracture
nodes.description: A fracture is a partial or complete break in the continuity of a bone, usually caused by trauma, excessive stress, or weakened bone. It may present with pain, swelling, deformity, and restricted movement.

nodes.label: Guillain-Barre Syndrome
nodes.description: Guillain Barre Syndrome (GB syndrome), a rare disease condition in which body’s immune system attacks part of the peripheral nervous system.

nodes.label: Hemifacial Spasm
nodes.description: Hemifacial spasm is a neurological disorder characterized by involuntary, intermittent contractions or twitching of the muscles on one side of the face.

nodes.label: Hepatitis B
nodes.description: Hepatitis B is a viral infection caused by the hepatitis B virus (HBV), primarily affecting the liver. It can cause acute or chronic liver inflammation and, in persistent cases, may lead to cirrhosis or liver cancer.

nodes.label: Hirschsprung'S Disease
nodes.description: Hirschsprung's disease is a congenital disorder in which certain portions of the large intestine lack normal nerve cells, resulting in impaired movement of intestinal contents.

nodes.label: Huntington’S Chorea
nodes.description: Huntington's chorea is an inherited neurodegenerative disorder characterized by progressive movement abnormalities, particularly involuntary jerky movements called chorea, along with cognitive and psychiatric changes.

nodes.label: Hypertension
nodes.description: Hypertension is a chronic condition in which blood pressure remains persistently elevated above the normal range.

nodes.label: Juvenile Spondyloarthritis
nodes.description: Juvenile spondyloarthritis is a group of inflammatory rheumatic disorders affecting children and adolescents, involving the joints and often the spine or areas where tendons attach to bone. It may cause pain, stiffness, swelling, and restricted movement.

nodes.label: Limb-Girdle Muscular Dystrophy
nodes.description: Limb-girdle muscular dystrophy is a group of inherited muscle disorders characterized by progressive weakness of the muscles around the hips and shoulders.

nodes.label: Low Anti-Mullerian Hormone (Amh) Level
nodes.description: A low anti-Müllerian hormone level indicates reduced levels of AMH, a hormone produced by ovarian follicles and commonly used as a marker of ovarian reserve.

nodes.label: Lumbar Disc Herniation
nodes.description: Lumbar disc herniation occurs when the inner material of an intervertebral disc protrudes through a weakened or damaged outer layer in the lower spine.

nodes.label: Lumbar Myelomeningocele
nodes.description: Lumbar myelomeningocele is a congenital neural tube defect in which the spinal cord and its coverings protrude through an opening in the lumbar vertebrae.

nodes.label: Lumbar Spondylosis
nodes.description: Lumbar spondylosis is a degenerative condition of the lumbar spine involving age-related changes in the vertebrae, discs, and facet joints. It may cause chronic low back pain, stiffness, and sometimes nerve-related symptoms.

nodes.label: Major Depressive Disorder
nodes.description: Major depressive disorder is a mental health condition characterized by persistent depressed mood or loss of interest or pleasure, accompanied by emotional, cognitive, and physical symptoms that significantly affect daily functioning.

nodes.label: Migraine
nodes.description: Migraine is a neurological disorder characterized by recurrent attacks of moderate to severe headache, often accompanied by nausea and sensitivity to light or sound.

nodes.label: Myopia
nodes.description: Myopia, or short-sightedness, is a refractive error in which distant objects appear blurred because light is focused in front of the retina rather than directly on it.

nodes.label: Nicolau Syndrome
nodes.description: Nicolau syndrome is a rare injection-related complication characterized by severe pain and skin changes occurring shortly after administration of an injection.

nodes.label: Non-Alcoholic Fatty Liver Disease
nodes.description: Non-alcoholic fatty liver disease is a condition characterized by excessive accumulation of fat in the liver in people without significant alcohol consumption.

nodes.label: Obesity
nodes.description: Obesity is a chronic condition characterized by excessive accumulation of body fat that may adversely affect health.

nodes.label: Oligoasthenozoospermia
nodes.description: Oligoasthenozoospermia is a male reproductive condition characterized by reduced sperm concentration (oligozoospermia) together with reduced sperm motility (asthenozoospermia).

nodes.label: Oligomenorrhea
nodes.description: Oligomenorrhea refers to menstrual periods that occur at unusually long intervals, resulting in infrequent menstruation.

nodes.label: Oligo-Teratozoospermia
nodes.description: Oligo-teratozoospermia is a condition affecting the normal sperm count and morphology leading to male factor infertility

nodes.label: Oligozoospermia
nodes.description: Oligozoospermia is a male reproductive condition characterized by a lower-than-normal concentration of sperm in the semen.

nodes.label: Oral Submucous Fibrosis
nodes.description: Oral submucous fibrosis is a chronic progressive disorder of the oral cavity characterized by inflammation and fibrosis of the mucosal tissues.

nodes.label: Osteoarthritis
nodes.description: Osteoarthritis is a degenerative joint disorder characterized by progressive deterioration of articular cartilage and changes in the underlying bone. It commonly causes joint pain, stiffness, swelling, and restricted movement.

nodes.label: Osteoporosis
nodes.description: Osteoporosis is a skeletal disorder characterized by reduced bone strength and increased susceptibility to fractures. It commonly affects the spine, hip, and wrist.

nodes.label: Ovarian Cyst
nodes.description: An ovarian cyst is a fluid-filled or solid sac that develops within or on the surface of an ovary.

nodes.label: Papilledema
nodes.description: Papilledema is swelling of the optic disc caused by increased intracranial pressure.

nodes.label: Poly Cystic Ovarian Disease
nodes.description: Polycystic ovarian disease is a condition characterized by multiple small follicles or cyst-like structures in the ovaries, often associated with hormonal and menstrual disturbances.

nodes.label: Poly Cystic Ovarian Syndrome
nodes.description: Polycystic ovarian syndrome is a common endocrine disorder characterized by hormonal imbalance, irregular or absent ovulation, and clinical or biochemical features of excess androgen.

nodes.label: Post-Traumatic Trigeminal Neuropathy
nodes.description: Post-traumatic trigeminal neuropathy is a disorder of the trigeminal nerve that develops following trauma or injury. It may cause persistent facial pain, numbness, tingling, or altered sensation in the affected area.

nodes.label: Prediabetes
nodes.description: Post-traumatic trigeminal neuropathy is a disorder of the trigeminal nerve that develops following trauma or injury. It may cause persistent facial pain, numbness, tingling, or altered sensation in the affected area.

nodes.label: Primary Insomnia
nodes.description: Primary insomnia refers to persistent difficulty falling asleep, staying asleep, or obtaining restorative sleep that is not primarily explained by another medical or psychiatric condition.

nodes.label: Progressive Bulbar Palsy
nodes.description: Progressive bulbar palsy is a neurodegenerative disorder affecting the motor neurons controlling the muscles involved in speech, swallowing, and facial movements.

nodes.label: Progressive Supranuclear Palsy
nodes.description: Progressive supranuclear palsy is a progressive neurodegenerative disorder characterized by problems with balance, movement, eye movements, and postural control.

nodes.label: Prurigo Nodularis
nodes.description: Prurigo nodularis is a chronic skin disorder characterized by intensely itchy, firm nodules that develop as a result of persistent scratching or rubbing. The lesions commonly occur on the arms, legs, and trunk.

nodes.label: Rheumatoid Arthritis
nodes.description: Rheumatoid arthritis is a chronic autoimmune inflammatory disorder that primarily affects the joints. It commonly causes symmetrical joint pain, swelling, stiffness, and progressive joint damage.

nodes.label: Sciatica
nodes.description: Sciatica refers to pain along the distribution of the sciatic nerve, usually caused by irritation or compression of a nerve root in the lower spine. It commonly produces pain radiating from the lower back or buttock into the leg.

nodes.label: Sclerosis
nodes.description: Sclerosis refers to abnormal hardening or thickening of tissue due to pathological changes, such as fibrosis or scarring. The term can describe several different conditions depending on the affected tissue or organ.

nodes.label: Sinusitis
nodes.description: Sinusitis is inflammation of the paranasal sinuses, often associated with nasal congestion, facial pressure or pain, nasal discharge, and reduced sense of smell.

nodes.label: Small Fibre Neuropathy
nodes.description: Small fibre neuropathy is a disorder affecting small sensory and autonomic nerve fibres. It commonly causes burning pain, tingling, altered temperature or pain sensation, and sometimes autonomic symptoms.

nodes.label: Spinal Cord Injury
nodes.description: Spinal cord injury is damage to the spinal cord resulting from trauma or other causes, potentially leading to impaired motor, sensory, and autonomic functions below the site of injury.

nodes.label: Spinocerebellar Ataxia
nodes.description: Spinocerebellar ataxia refers to a group of inherited neurodegenerative disorders characterized by progressive impairment of coordination and balance due to dysfunction of the cerebellum and related neural pathways.

nodes.label: Spinocerebellar Ataxia Type 2
nodes.description: Spinocerebellar ataxia type 2 is an inherited neurodegenerative disorder caused by a genetic mutation affecting the nervous system.

nodes.label: Spondyloepiphyseal Dysplasia Tarda
nodes.description: Spondyloepiphyseal dysplasia tarda is a rare inherited skeletal disorder primarily affecting the spine and the growth and development of the ends of long bones.

nodes.label: Takayasu Arteritis
nodes.description: Takayasu arteritis is a rare large-vessel inflammatory disease that primarily affects the aorta and its major branches.

nodes.label: Traumatic Optic Neuropathy
nodes.description: Traumatic optic neuropathy is damage to the optic nerve resulting from trauma to the head or eye. It can cause sudden or progressive reduction in vision and other visual disturbances.

nodes.label: Trigeminal Neuralgia
nodes.description: Trigeminal neuralgia is a neurological disorder characterized by recurrent, sudden episodes of severe, brief, electric-shock-like pain affecting one or more branches of the trigeminal nerve, usually on one side of the face.

nodes.label: Tubal Blockage
nodes.description: Tubal blockage refers to obstruction of one or both fallopian tubes, preventing normal movement of the egg and sperm through the reproductive tract. It is an important cause of female infertility.

nodes.label: Type 2 Diabetes
nodes.description: Type 2 diabetes is a chronic metabolic disorder characterized by elevated blood glucose levels due primarily to insulin resistance and progressive impairment of insulin secretion.

nodes.label: Type 2 Diabetes Mellitus
nodes.description: Type 2 diabetes mellitus is the same metabolic condition commonly referred to as type 2 diabetes, characterized by persistent hyperglycaemia resulting from insulin resistance and inadequate insulin secretion.

nodes.label: Ulcerative Colitis
nodes.description: Ulcerative colitis is a chronic inflammatory bowel disease characterized by inflammation and ulceration of the lining of the colon and rectum. It commonly causes abdominal pain, diarrhoea, rectal bleeding, and urgency.

nodes.label: Ulcerative Keratitis
nodes.description: Ulcerative keratitis is an inflammatory condition of the cornea associated with corneal ulceration. It may cause eye pain, redness, photophobia, tearing, and impaired vision and requires prompt medical attention.

nodes.label: Urethral Stricture
nodes.description: Urethral stricture is abnormal narrowing of the urethra caused by scar tissue or other structural changes. It can obstruct urinary flow and cause difficulty or discomfort during urination.

nodes.label: Urinary Incontinence
nodes.description: Urinary incontinence is the involuntary leakage of urine due to impaired control of bladder storage or emptying.

nodes.label: Uterine Fibroids
nodes.description: Uterine fibroid is not only the commonest benign tumour of uterus but also the commonest solid tumour in female that usually found in approximately 20 to 40% women of reproductive age group,1 start as multiple, single cell seedlings distributed throughout the uterine wall.

nodes.label: Vasculitis
nodes.description: Vasculitis is chronic inflammation resulting in necrosis of blood vessels due to narrowing or occlusion of the lumen.

nodes.label: Venous Ulcer
nodes.description: A venous ulcer is a chronic wound that commonly develops on the lower leg due to impaired venous circulation and increased pressure within the veins. It is often associated with swelling, skin changes, and poor wound healing.

nodes.label: Pityriasis Rubra Pilaris
nodes.description: Pityriasis rubra pilaris is a rare chronic inflammatory skin disorder characterized by reddish-orange scaly patches, follicular papules, and areas of relatively normal skin. It may involve the scalp, face, trunk, and limbs.

nodes.label: Acute Renal Calculus
nodes.description: An acute renal calculus refers to the sudden clinical presentation of a kidney stone, formed by crystallization of substances within the urinary tract.

nodes.label: Rett Syndrome
nodes.description: Rett syndrome is a rare genetic neurodevelopmental disorder that primarily affects females. It is characterized by normal early development followed by loss of acquired skills, impaired communication, repetitive hand movements, and problems with coordination.

nodes.label: Neurogenic Bladder
nodes.description: Neurogenic bladder is a dysfunction of bladder storage or emptying caused by abnormalities of the nervous system. It may result in urinary retention, urgency, frequency, or involuntary urine leakage.

nodes.label: Knee Osteoarthritis
nodes.description: Knee osteoarthritis is a degenerative joint disorder involving progressive deterioration of the cartilage and other structures of the knee. It commonly causes knee pain, stiffness, swelling, and difficulty with movement or walking

nodes.label: Irritable Bowel Syndrome
nodes.description: Irritable bowel syndrome is a functional gastrointestinal disorder characterized by recurrent abdominal pain associated with changes in bowel habits, including diarrhoea, constipation, or both, without an identifiable structural cause.

nodes.label: Lumbo-Sacral Disorder
nodes.description: A lumbo-sacral disorder refers to a condition affecting the lumbar and sacral regions of the lower spine. It may cause lower back pain, stiffness, restricted movement, or nerve-related symptoms affecting the lower limbs.

nodes.label: Piles
nodes.description: Piles, also known as haemorrhoids, are swollen and enlarged veins in the lower rectum or anus. They may cause rectal bleeding, discomfort, itching, or a lump around the anal region.

nodes.label: Chronic Kidney Disease
nodes.description: Chronic Kidney Disease (CKD) is the gradual irreversible damage to kidney function that occurs in both kidneys. This disease is marked by a sustained kidney damage or decreased functioning for at least three months.

nodes.label: Lumbar Spinal Stenosis
nodes.description: Lumbar spinal stenosis is abnormal narrowing of spinal canal at lumbar region, may occur as a result of progression of spondylotic changes.

nodes.label: Diabetic Neuropathy
nodes.description: Diabetic neuropathy symptoms include pain, numbness, reduced sensation of touch or oversensitivity, uncomfortable tingling and burning, skin ulcer and reduced reflexes.

nodes.label: Global Developmental Delay
nodes.description: A child with global developmental delay is unable to attain developmental milestones owing to brain damage which leads to impairment in gross and fine motor, personal social, speech, and activities of daily living.

nodes.label: Post-Thrombotic Syndrome
nodes.description: Post-thrombotic syndrome is a chronic complication of deep vein thrombosis caused by damage to the veins and their valves.

nodes.label: Fibromyalgia
nodes.description: Fibromyalgia (FM) is a or musculoskeletal condition characterized by chronic widespread musculoskeletal pain and tenderness including associated neuropsychological symptoms including fatigue, unrefreshing sleep, cognitive dysfunction, anxiety, and depression.

nodes.label: Adhesive Capsulitis Stage 2
nodes.description: Adhesive capsulitis often referred to as frozen shoulder, is one of the long term complication of Diabetes mellitus which causes gradual loss of motion in shoulder.

nodes.label: Necrozoospermia
nodes.description: Necrozoospermia (also called necrospermia) is a rare semen disorder where most or all of the sperm present in a semen sample are dead or non-viable.

nodes.label: Vipadika
nodes.description: Vipadika or Vaipadika is explained as one among Eleven Kshudra Kushtas (Minor skin ailments) which has the features of Paanipaada sputana (Cracking of palms and soles) associated with Teevravedana (Intense pain) as explained by Acharya Charaka.

nodes.label: Hemiplegia
nodes.description: Hemiplegia is the commonest manifestation of a Stroke with neurological deficit affecting the face, limbs and trunk on one side or either side of the body.

nodes.label: Lumbar Disc Disease
nodes.description: Lumbar disc disease (LDD) is a common cause of chronic or recurrent low back and leg pain, most frequently affecting the L4–L5 and L5–S1 levels. The pain may be localized to the lower back or may radiate to the leg, buttocks, or hip.

nodes.label: Hirayama Disease
nodes.description: Hirayama disease (HD) is a juvenile nonprogressive amyotrophy disease. It is characterized by gradual onset of muscular dystrophy in the distal part of the upper limbs related to flexion movements of the cervical spine.

nodes.label: Infertility
nodes.description: Infertility is the inability to achieve pregnancy after regular unprotected sexual intercourse for a specified period. It may result from factors affecting ovulation, reproductive organs, sperm function, hormonal balance, or other reproductive factors.

nodes.label: Senile Dementia
nodes.description: Senile dementia is a syndrome due to disease of the brain, usually of a chronic or progressive nature, in which there is disturbance of multiple higher cortical functions, without any impairment in consciousness. Prevalence rates for senile dementia increase essentially with advancing age.

nodes.label: Psoriasis Vulgaris
nodes.description: Psoriasis vulgaris, commonly known as plaque psoriasis, is the most frequent form of an autoimmune skin condition. It causes the rapid buildup of skin cells, leading to raised, inflamed patches covered with silvery-white or gray scales.

nodes.label: Visphota Kushta
nodes.description: Visphota Kushta is a traditional Ayurvedic classification for blistering skin diseases characterized by thin-skinned, transparent, or fluid-filled vesicles and bullae.

nodes.label: Scalp Psoriasis
nodes.description: Scalp psoriasis is a common, chronic autoimmune condition where an overactive immune system speeds up skin cell growth.

nodes.label: Psychogenic Pseudomyasthenic Ptosis
nodes.description: Psychogenic pseudo-myasthenic ptosis is a rare functional neurological (conversion) symptom where a person experiences a drooping eyelid that mimics myasthenia gravis, but has psychological rather than physical origins.

nodes.label: Chronic Lymphocytic Leukemia
nodes.description: Chronic lymphocytic leukemia is a type of blood cancer characterized by the abnormal accumulation of mature but functionally impaired lymphocytes, most commonly B lymphocytes. It generally progresses slowly and may initially produce few symptoms.

nodes.label: Hyperlipidemia
nodes.description: Hyperlipidemia refers to abnormally elevated levels of lipids in the blood, particularly cholesterol and triglycerides.

nodes.label: Meibomian Gland Dysfunction
nodes.description: Meibomian gland dysfunction is a disorder in which the oil-producing meibomian glands of the eyelids do not function normally. It can destabilize the tear film and cause dry, irritated, burning, or gritty eyes.

nodes.label: Wounds
nodes.description: A wound is a disruption or injury to the normal structure and integrity of body tissue, usually involving the skin or underlying tissues. It may result from trauma, surgery, infection, or other pathological processes.

nodes.label: Haemorrhoids
nodes.description: Haemorrhoids are swollen and enlarged veins in the lower rectum or anus. They may cause rectal bleeding, pain or discomfort, itching, and swelling around the anal region.

nodes.label: Bipolar Affective Disorder
nodes.description: Bipolar Affective Disorder (BPAD) is a recurrent and chronic disorder that is characterized by episodes of depression and elevated mood with intervening periods of normal mood.

nodes.label: Liver Cirrhosis With Ascites
nodes.description: Liver cirrhosis with ascites refers to advanced scarring of the liver accompanied by accumulation of fluid within the abdominal cavity.

nodes.label: Marichadi Taila
